# H repeat is an account problem

> Repeat escalations from one account are an account problem, not a ticket problem. Stop solving them one at a time.


## The heuristic

**Repeat escalations from one account are an account problem, not a ticket problem. Stop solving them one at a time.**


_Why:_ A single escalation is about an issue; a pattern is about a mismatch — wrong plan, wrong onboarding, a product area that does not fit their use case, or a named contact who has learned escalation is the only path that works. Fixing the tickets leaves the generator running.
